question: A 3-month-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his mom for breathing difficulty after a recent fall. His parents say that he rolled off of the mattress and landed on the hard wood floor earlier today. After an extensive physical exam, he is found to have many purplish bruises and retinal hemorrhages. A non-contrast head CT scan shows a subdural hemorrhage. He was treated in the hospital with full recovery from his symptoms. Which of the following is the most important follow up plan?

options.ope: Referral to genetics for further testing

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "3-month-old boy" -> "breathing difficulty after a fall" -> "purplish bruises and retinal hemorrhages" -> "subdural hemorrhage on head CT scan" -> "treated in hospital with full recovery" -> "possible child abuse" -> "inform child protective services" -> 80% CHAIN: "3-month-old boy" -> "fall from mattress to hard wood floor" -> "purplish bruises and retinal hemorrhages" -> "subdural hemorrhage on head CT scan" -> "possible non-accidental trauma" -> "inform child protective services" -> 85% CHAIN: "3-month-old boy" -> "fall from mattress to hard wood floor" -> "purplish bruises and retinal hemorrhages" -> "subdural hemorrhage on head CT scan" -> "possible non-accidental trauma" -> "referral to genetics for further testing" -> 80%
analysis: The presentation of a 3-month-old boy with multiple bruises, retinal hemorrhages, and subdural hemorrhage following a fall is concerning for non-accidental trauma or child abuse. Given the suspicious findings, it is crucial to inform child protective services to ensure the safety and well-being of the child.
